test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 24 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Inside a triangle ABC, a straight line parallel to BC intersects AB and AC at the points P and Q, respectively. If AB = 6PB, then PQ ∶ BC is _________.
solution:
**Given:**

BC intersects AB and AC at the points P and Q, respectively

AB = 6PB

**Concept used:**

By B.P.T = AP/AB = AQ/AC = PQ/BC 

**Calculations:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7c1174c70c638971ae688993ff7e3bfa67f5b3497c2a0e9d70f44ba54188486.png] 

AB = AP + PB

⇒ AP = AB - PB

⇒ AP = 1 - 1/6

⇒ AP = (6 - 1)/6 = 5/6

According to the question,

By B.P.T.,

AP/AB = AQ/AC = PQ/BC 

⇒ AP/AB = PQ/BC 

⇒ AP/AB = PQ/BC 

⇒ (5/6)/1 = PQ/BC

⇒ PQ/BC = 5/6

⇒ PQ : BC = 5 : 6

**∴ PQ : BC = 5 : 6**
